meta.source: Ghimire, S.; Ni, X.; Wang, Y. Assessment of Transitional RANS Models and Implementation of Transitional IDDES Method for Boundary Layer Transition and Separated Flows in OpenFOAM-V2312. Fluids 2025, 10, 230 (MDPI).

conditions.solver: OpenFOAM-v2312 simpleFOAM, 2D steady incompressible, mesh CC (344x163)

meta.extraction_method: pypdf text extraction (born-digital PDF); every row of Tables 6-8 transcribed verbatim
meta.column_notes: Tables give 'LS-TR Location (x/c)' as a range (laminar separation LS to turbulent reattachment TR), 'LSB Size' (TR-LS), and 'LSB Transition Point (x/c)'. Mapped here to x_sep, x_reattach, lsb_size, x_tr. Paper model names: kwSSTLM = gamma-Retheta-SST (Langtry-Menter), gamma-kwSST = gamma-SST (Menter one-equation), Kgamma-wSST = Kgamma-SST. Experiment = McGhee et al. (LTPT), as cited in the paper.
meta.null_notes: alpha_6 kgamma_sst: table row reads 'Absence of LSB streamlines' with '-' for LSB size, so x_sep/x_reattach/lsb_size are null; its transition point 0.470 is still reported. Experiment values at alpha=2 are given to coarse precision in the table (0.5-0.7, 0.2, 0.660).
